summary: Add explicit store-mode pin (additive 'storeMode' parameter) to createServer, createJobStore, createTimerStore, createOutboxStore, and handleRequest so that tests can declare in-memory store usage without relying on ambient DATABASE_URL absence. Fix externalWorker.e2e.test.ts (7 failing tests in default-store suite) and health.test.ts (2 failing tests AC-1/AC-4) to pass both with and without ambient DATABASE_URL.
functional: FR-1: createJobStore/createTimerStore/createOutboxStore accept additive optional mode?: 'auto' | 'memory'; 'memory' forces in-memory regardless of DATABASE_URL
FR-2: createServer accepts additive optional third parameter storeMode?: 'auto' | 'memory', forwarded to all three store factories
FR-3: handleRequest accepts additive optional third parameter storeMode?: 'auto' | 'memory'; module-level lazy router cache is keyed by mode to prevent cross-contamination
FR-4: externalWorker.e2e.test.ts 'default store' beforeAll calls createServer(undefined, undefined, 'memory')
FR-5: health.test.ts all four handleRequest(req, res) calls pass 'memory' as third argument
FR-6: StoreMode type exported from server.ts
non_functional: NF-1: additive only — no existing call sites modified; all zero/one-arg signatures preserved backward-compatible
NF-2: explicit storeMode parameter is immune to vitest forked-worker env mutation issues
NF-3: mode parameter does not change http.Server interface or Router dispatch protocol
NF-4: health handler is synchronous in memory mode (no PostgresJobStore branch, no timerStore, no outboxStore) — satisfies synchronous assertion pattern in health.test.ts
NF-5: no new files; changes in src/server.ts and two test files only
out_of_scope: Changing production env-selection logic ('auto' mode behaviour frozen)
Fixing the async/synchronous health.test.ts pattern beyond store-mode pin
